findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizer solution to be available upon arrival. Discussed with PIC, sanitizer bucket was made and tested at 200 ppm QUat. Ensure a sanitizer solution is available and at the proper concentration.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: Observed no certified food manager to be present upon arrival. DIscussed with PIC, ensure a certified food manager to present within facility during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Observed no sanitizer solution to be made upon inspection. Discussed with PIC, triple sink was set up and tested at 200 ppm. Ensure sanitizer solution is available and made during all hours of operation. 

4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
750-160  Food shall be protected at all times from cross-contamination.

Observed the nozel on the soda gun in the bar area to be heavily soiled. When the nozzel was removed from the soda gun, more soilage was observed. Discussed cleaning practices with the PIC and instructed to clean often enough so as to prevent accumulation on the food contact surfaces and prevent contamination of foods.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment: 750-160  Food shall be protected at all times from cross-contamination. The holder that the soda gun nozzel rests in had a build up of bacteria. Showed this to the person in charge and explained how this was an issue for possible cross contamination. The employees cleaned the holder during the inspection.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750. 800 Observed the ice machine flap to have pink mold.  clean the ice flap.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment: 750. 151- Observed a sausage, egg and cheese sandwich dated 9/17. The sandwich was discarded during the inspection.  Make sure to discard items after 30 days from thawing. Any other PHF must be used/discarded within 7 days.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment: 750.120a (REPEAT)  No cover on ice bin. Keep lid closed to protect ice during slow times.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment: 750.120a: Absence of cover on ice bin.  Ice is used for drinks.  Cover ice bin when not in use to protect from contamination.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b: Observed plastic piece inside ice machine to be soiled with a little mold build-up. Clean and sanitize plastic piece inside ice machine.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e: Observed the ceiling in the walk-in cooler upstairs to be soiled with mold accumulation. Clean the ceiling and around the fan often to make sure mold does not accumulate.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment: 750.1240a: Absence of light shields on bulbs at bar over ice bin and over 3 compartment sink. Provide light shields or shatter-proof bulbs to protect against broken glass.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment: 850, 860: The utensil storage drawer (directly beneath the microwave) has crumbs within the utensil organizer trays. Clean and sanitize the trays so clean utensils are stored clean.
